role: FACTORY DEFAULT (Layer 1/2 shared core). NOT a per-user config. Every customer inherits this as the out-of-box default and OVERRIDES it per-task in their own Layer-3 file '.forge/provider-prefs.json' (see v5.0 architecture SS5.4). The router resolves: customer .forge/provider-prefs.json first -> this factory default second. This file is provider-and-task neutral: task categories are universal, model picks are best-per-category, NOT any one operator's preferences. Edit this only to change the shipped DEFAULT for all customers; a single customer changes nothing here.
description: Data-driven per-task model selection. Replaces hardcoded model names in rule files (per tech-defaults.md). tech-radar agent proposes refreshes to PENDING_APPROVALS; the factory operator approves changes to the DEFAULT. Per-customer overrides never touch this file. Every model id + price below was sourced from a live provider page on 2026-05-30, re-verified 2026-07-24 (gemini-3.6-flash add + vision_ocr swap; grok-4.5 cataloged-not-preferred).

hard_caps.cap_note_2026-06-09: per_task_usd raised 5.00 -> 15.00 for the Fable-5 enablement (the project owner-approved): deep_program's whole point is full-1M-context runs, and a single full-context claude-fable-5 call costs ~$13.20 ($10.00 input at 1M + $3.20 output at 64K). At 5.00 checkAndReserve would hard-stop every legitimate deep_program estimate pre-dispatch -- wired but unusable. The cap is GLOBAL (lib/router has no per-category factory cap); cheaper categories should be capped lower per-customer via .forge/provider-prefs.json max_cost_per_task_cents, which can only LOWER this ceiling, never raise it.
hard_caps.note: per_task_usd gates the pre-dispatch ESTIMATE per-call: lib/router/budget.ts checkAndReserve hard-stops a single call whose estimate exceeds it BEFORE dispatch, even when no monthly budget is passed (F1 2026-06-03). It does NOT cap ACTUAL settled cost -- a caller that under-estimates (low estimatedCents + large maxTokens) can settle above it; route() then flags RouteResult.costOverPerTaskCap + warns to stderr (no refund -- spend already happened, Bug-1) so the overage is observable, never silently presented as within-cap (F6). The MONTHLY cap is enforced when a caller passes budgetCentsPerMonth (atomic check-and-reserve against .forge/budget-ledger.jsonl). per_session_usd is NOT yet enforced -- route() has no session identity; tracked follow-up (needs a sessionId on RouteArgs + session-scoped sum). No silent overrun on the gated caps. Per VIBE Rule 21 + 58.

claude-sonnet-5.notes: Introductory pricing $2.00/$10.00 per Mtok through 2026-08-31, reverting to standard $3.00/$15.00 thereafter. New tokenizer produces ~30% more tokens for the same text vs claude-sonnet-4-6 -- flat per-token price, higher effective per-task cost. Adaptive-thinking-only API surface (temperature/top_p/top_k return 400 if set) -- same as claude-fable-5.

grok-4.5._routing_note: CATALOGED, NOT PREFERRED. 60% more expensive on input and 140% on output than grok-4.3, with HALF the context (500K vs 1M). x_data work is retrieval-shaped, not reasoning-shaped, so 4.3 remains the default; escalate to 4.5 only for genuinely hard agentic/coding X-adjacent work.

sonar-pro.request_fee_note: PLUS $6-$14 per 1K requests by search context size -- NOT modeled in cost (token-only undercount; see provider-expansion.md SS2.5)

sonar-reasoning-pro.request_fee_note: PLUS $6-$14 per 1K requests by search context size -- NOT modeled in cost

deep_program.rationale: Fable 5 ($10/$50) is the frontier tier ABOVE Opus: deepest reasoning, long-horizon agentic runs, full-1M-context program synthesis. Reserve for the hardest multi-file programs where Opus has been insufficient or the whole context must be held at once; everything routine stays on architecture/code_build. Single full-context call ~= $13.20 -- per-task cap raised to $15 to admit it (see hard_caps.cap_note_2026-06-09). Added 2026-06-09, the project owner pre-approved (Fable-5 enablement).

architecture.rationale: Opus 4.8 leads complex multi-file planning + adaptive reasoning + 1M ctx.

code_build.rationale: Sonnet 5 succeeds 4.6 as best speed/quality/cost ($3/$15, intro $2/$10 through 2026-08-31); note ~30% more tokens/request under the new tokenizer vs 4.6 -- still best-in-class per Anthropic's own positioning. claude-sonnet-4-6 remains in the models catalog (still Active) but is no longer preferred/fallback anywhere.

quick_edit.rationale: Haiku 4.5 fastest Claude ($1/$5); gpt-5.4-mini competitive fallback.

vision_ocr.rationale: Gemini leads vision/OCR per existing mcp-servers.md routing. 3.6 Flash succeeds 3.5 Flash at the SAME input price and a LOWER output price ($1.50/$7.50 vs $1.50/$9.00) -- a pure cost decrease, ~17% off output, with a larger verified context (1,048,576). 3.5 Flash demoted to first fallback, not deprecated.

x_data.rationale: Only family with real-time X corpus. grok-4.3 STAYS preferred at $1.25/$2.50 with 1M ctx: grok-4.5 (now GA, $2/$6, 500K ctx) is a real price INCREASE for retrieval-shaped X work and halves the context. 4.5 sits in fallback as a deliberate escalation path for hard agentic/coding tasks only.

research.rationale: GPT-5.4 strong web-research synthesis; Grok for X-adjacent. Unchanged: general unsourced research synthesis.

research_cited.rationale: Perplexity for CITED real-time web/market research (CLAUDE.md SS2: competitive research + market sizing). Consumers: the deep-research skill + cited-lookup flows call route({taskCategory:'research_cited'}) when they need sourced answers. Distinct from 'research' (unsourced synthesis). Ratified by the project owner 2026-06-02 (provider-expansion.md SS2.3).

data_qa.rationale: Sonnet 5 reliable structured Q&A, succeeds 4.6; gpt-4.1 cost-effective fallback.

marketing_copy.rationale: Opus 4.8 least template-shaped output per anti-slop rules.

agent_dispatch.rationale: Haiku ($1/$5) minimizes dispatch-loop cost; gpt-4.1-mini cheapest 1M ctx.
